            <title><![CDATA[What Trump picking Stephen Miller for chief of staff signals about his agenda]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/what-trump-picking-stephen-miller-for-chief-of-staff-signals-about-his-agenda</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Trump has replaced White House chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller, the hardline architect of his immigration agenda, after a crushing midterm defeat. Immigration, once a political strength for Trump, became a liability after two years of mass detentions, deportations and armed agents in U.S. cities. Miller's appointment signals a doubling down on Trump's agenda. Liz Landers reports.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[News Wrap: Judge blocks construction of Trump's triumphal arch for now]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/news-wrap-judge-blocks-construction-of-trumps-triumphal-arch-for-now</link>
            <description><![CDATA[In our news wrap Friday, Trump's plans to build a massive triumphal arch near Arlington National Cemetery have been put on hold, two more top officials resigned from the Justice Department, residents along the Georgia-Tennessee border are returning home after record floodwaters receded, Pope Leo started his 12-day tour of Latin America, and Tesla will wind down production of its Cybertruck.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[What to know about a better-than-expected jobs report amid AI bubble concerns]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/what-to-know-about-a-better-than-expected-jobs-report-amid-ai-bubble-concerns</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Employers added 165,000 new jobs in October, according to a new government report. Job gains for August and September were revised upward as well, by a combined 84,000 jobs. That makes the last three months of the job market look better than expected, but it comes as questions grow about the sustainability of the AI boom. Amna Nawaz speaks with Diane Swonk, chief economist for KPMG, for more.]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/sen-elect-hamilton-reflects-on-why-kansas-voters-chose-a-democrat-for-u-s-senate</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Democrats' midterm wins have reached red states across the country, including Kansas, which has not sent a Democrat to the U.S. Senate since 1932. That will soon change after Rev. Adam Hamilton, who leads the largest United Methodist church in the country, defeated Republican incumbent Roger Marshall Tuesday night.             <title><![CDATA[Georgia Gov.-elect Bottoms reflects on historic victory and the path forward for Democrats]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/georgia-gov-elect-bottoms-reflects-on-historic-victory-and-the-path-forward-for-democrats</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Georgia voters made history this week, electing Keisha Lance Bottoms as the state's first Democratic senator in more than two decades and the first-ever Black woman governor in the country. Geoff Bennett speaks with Gov.-elect Bottoms for more.]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/remembering-jay-rockefellers-life-and-legacy-of-public-service</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Jay Rockefeller, former West Virginia governor and longtime U.S. senator, has died at age 89.
